授業概要
本科目では、因果推論の主要手法を用いた実証研究論文をジャーナルクラブ形式で精読・発表・議論する。第1回で因果推論の枠組みとジャーナルクラブの進め方を概説し、第2回以降は手法別に経済学トップ5ジャーナルの論文を取り上げる。受講者は担当論文のプレゼンテーションを行い、全員で議論に参加する。
This course is a journal club on causal inference. Students read, present, and discuss empirical papers from top-5 economics journals. The first session provides an overview of causal inference frameworks and journal club procedures. From the second session onward, papers are organized by identification strategy (RCT, IV, RDD, DID, etc.). Each student presents an assigned paper, followed by group discussion.

使用する教材等
スライド資料（電子媒体）
全体の教育目標
Students will develop the ability to critically read and evaluate empirical research in economics, with a focus on causal inference methods.
個別の教育目標
1. Understand major identification strategies (RCT, IV, RDD, DID, Synthetic Control, Matching).
2. Critically evaluate the empirical design and findings of published research.
3. Effectively present and communicate research to an academic audience.
授業計画
Session 1: Introduction — Overview of causal inference (potential outcomes, selection bias, key identification strategies); journal club format and expectations.
Session 2: RCT — Student presentation and discussion of an RCT paper from a top-5 journal.
Session 3: Instrumental Variables — Student presentation and discussion of an IV paper.
Session 4: Regression Discontinuity Design — Student presentation and discussion of an RDD paper.
Session 5: Difference-in-Differences — Student presentation and discussion of a DID paper.
Session 6: Synthetic Control / Panel Methods — Student presentation and discussion.
Session 7: Matching / Selection on Observables — Student presentation and discussion; course wrap-up.
キーワード
Causal Inference, Journal Club, RCT, Instrumental Variables, RDD, DID, Empirical Economics
授業の進め方
Session 1 is a lecture by the instructor. Sessions 2-7 follow a journal club format: one student presents the assigned paper (approx. 30 min), followed by group discussion (approx. 60 min). All students are expected to read the paper before each session and prepare discussion points.
テキスト

参考書
Selected papers from AER, Econometrica, JPE, QJE, and REStud. Specific papers will be assigned by the instructor before each session.
